Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Change le format de tes fichiers : gliss: Change your files' format: drag them in, pick the output format, and the converted file is created next to the original, never overwritten. Images (PNG, JPG, WebP, ICO, AVIF…), sounds (MP3, WAV, FLAC…), videos (MP4, WebM, animated GIF, audio only), spreadsheets (Excel, ODS, CSV, JSON) and documents (Word, Markdown, HTML to PDF). Adjustable size, quality and square crop; ffmpeg required for media. Compress a video for Discord (MP4 under 10 MB), before and after with the space saved, two columns on large screens.
Images, sons, vidéos, tableaux (Excel, O: Images, sounds, videos, tables (Excel, ODS, CSV, JSON) and documents (Word, Markdown, HTML, text → PDF, etc.). The converted file is created alongside the original, which is never modified.
La taille, la qualité et le recadrage s': Size, quality, and cropping apply to images and videos.
Les fichiers choisis apparaissent ici, a: Chosen files appear here, each with its output format to pick.
Rien n'est synchronisé : les fichiers co: Nothing is synchronized: the converted files remain on the PC.
ffmpeg introuvable : seuls les tableaux: ffmpeg not found: only tables and documents can be converted.
Un clic règle toute la liste : format, t: One click sets the whole list: format, size and quality.
Vidéos en MP4 sous 10 Mo, images en WebP: Videos in MP4 under 10 MB, images in WebP 1920 px, sounds in MP3: everything goes through without Nitro.
Vidéos en MP4 sous 16 Mo, images en JPG: Videos in MP4 under 16 MB, images in JPG 1920 px, sounds in MP3.
Vidéos sous 25 Mo, images en JPG 1280 px: Videos under 25 MB, light JPG images at 1280 px, documents in PDF.
Images en PNG carrées de 256 px (vignett: Images as square 256 px PNG (thumbnails, shortcut icons).
